svg.title: Agent Substrate multiplexes 250 agents onto 8 warm worker pods
svg.desc: Agents are idle most of the time. Idle agents suspend, resume on any ready worker, and keep their memory and filesystem state. The atenet router routes requests and resumes suspended agents onto 8 warm worker pods.
svg.text: Agents are idle most of the time.
several agents per pod, each in its own sandbox
Idle agents suspend, resume on any ready worker,
and keep their memory and filesystem state.

text.tspan: kubectl ate create actor my-agent --template counter
